claim.name: godray
claim.label: Intensity
claim.description: Warm amber light shafts radiate from a rotating source, accumulated by marching many samples weighted by decay, with drifting dust shimmer and front-to-back volumetric depth.

claim.name: supernova
claim.label: Nova Rate
claim.description: A star detonates — a blinding core flash expanding into a shock shell of light and debris, fading to a glowing remnant. Looping volumetric burst.

claim.name: volumetric-cone
claim.label: Sweep
claim.description: A cone of volumetric light beams down from a point, dust motes drifting in the shaft as it slowly sweeps.

claim.name: dust-cloud
claim.label: Drift
claim.description: A drifting cloud of fine dust catches light — soft low-density haze slowly billowing sideways through real depth with motes glinting.

claim.name: ink-bloom
claim.label: Speed
claim.description: A drop of ink blooms into water — a dark organic cloud unfurling and diffusing through depth with feathered, curling tendrils.

claim.name: mist-drift
claim.label: Drift
claim.description: A low, thin mist drifts slowly sideways across the scene — soft, near-transparent, ground-hugging haze with real front-to-back depth.

claim.name: wispy-smoke
claim.label: Rise
claim.description: Thin curling wisps of smoke rise and dissipate through real depth, slower and softer than billowing smoke.
